svg.title: Everyone who tests positive in the screening example, one square per person
svg.desc: Icon array of 585 squares, one per person who tested positive. 90 dark orange squares mark people who have the condition; 495 light blue squares mark false positives. About 15% of positives have the condition.
svg.text: The 585 people out of 10,000 who test positive (one square per person)
90 of 585 ≈ 15% have the condition; 495 of 585 ≈ 85% are false positives.
